jobDescription: Junior Data Engineer, Acme Analytics (Bengaluru, hybrid). You will build and maintain ETL pipelines in Python and SQL, orchestrate them with Airflow, load data into a cloud warehouse (BigQuery or Redshift), and containerise services with Docker.
